choices.name: Lord of Light
effects: Your basic attacks trigger Light of Saradomin 5x at random tiles near your target, each damaging up to 8 targets within 1 tile.
Light of Saradomin deals 2% increased damage for each point of Prayer bonus you have.
Light of Saradomin now heals you for 5% of damage dealt.

excluded: Random tile placement and target overlap are represented by the Targets in area scenario rather than spatial simulation.
assumptions: Only post-modernisation Basic Attacks trigger the effect; ordinary basic abilities and legacy autoattacks do not.
The five Light strikes share the 40-60% ability damage plus 250% armour formula disclosed for Light of Saradomin by Striking Light; Lord of Light does not restate a base formula.
Prayer bonus multiplies each Light hit after its ability-damage and armour terms. Each strike hits the selected Targets in area count, capped at 8.
Lord of Light and Striking Light have independent cooldowns. Lord's Prayer scaling and 5% healing apply to either source's Light of Saradomin hit.
Each Light is a separate crit-eligible hit. Healing is floor(5% of expected damage) per target hit.

choices.name: Tearing Thorns
effects: Damage over time abilities last 100% longer.
Every 5th hit of a damage over time ability triggers a Grasp of Guthix.
Grasp of Guthix deals additional damage equal to 20-30% of your maximum life points.
Grasp of Guthix deals poison damage equal to 80-120% of your ability damage, in a 3x3 area.

excluded: Grasp of Guthix life point damage
assumptions: Displayed in Builds only; gameplay effects intentionally unwired.

choices.name: Unholy Critual
effects: Your critical strike chance is capped at 50%.
All excess critical strike chance is converted into critical strike damage at a 1:1 ratio.
Inferno of Zamorak gains 50% critical strike damage.
On critical strike, unleash an Inferno of Zamorak.

assumptions: Displayed in Builds only; gameplay effects intentionally unwired.

reason: Wire Lord of Light into modern Basic Attacks, independent Light cooldown state, Prayer scaling, explicit area-target strikes, and healing. The unstated Light damage basis reuses the Striking Light formula from revision 37138315 and remains marked unverified.

assumptions: The passive timer starts at combat tick 0 and grants 6 adrenaline on every second tick, with the first pulse at tick 2.
Passive pulses use the simulator's canonical clock and clamp to the resolved maximum adrenaline.

choices.name: Envenomed
effects: Poison damage is increased by 50%, plus an additional 2% per Herblore level.
Damaging an enemy disables their poison immunity for 30 seconds.

assumptions: The selected Herblore level is clamped to the skill's 1-120 range; poison damage is multiplied by 1.5 plus 0.02 per level.
Every positive-damage hit starts or refreshes a 50-tick half-open poison-immunity override. The triggering hit can apply poison after the override is set.

choices.name: Perfidious
effects: Inferno of Zamorak activation chance is increased by 5x.
Grasp of Guthix activation requirement is reduced to 2.
Light of Saradomin cooldown is reduced to 4.8 seconds.

assumptions: Displayed in Builds only; gameplay effects intentionally unwired.

reason: Wire Tempered Heart as a six-adrenaline pulse every two game ticks on the canonical simulation clock while preserving Envenomed's existing combat rules.

assumptions: Prayer bonus is 5 times the number of unique paths in the six persisted path choices and contributes to Prayer-scaled effects such as Lord of Light and Icyenic Faith.

reason: Wire the sourced True Equilibrium Prayer bonus because Lord of Light scales from every point of Prayer bonus; retain all other True Equilibrium stats as excluded.
Store True Equilibrium's sourced 5 Prayer bonus per unique chosen path for shared League stat resolution.

body: Basic attacks unleash Light of Saradomin on the target on a 9-second cooldown for 40-60% ability damage plus 250% of armour value.
reason: Correct Striking Light to the current post-2026 Basic Attack wording from effect-template revision 37138315.

assumptions: Striking Light's +40% modifier and Light trigger apply only to the four post-modernisation Basic Attacks; ordinary basic abilities and legacy autoattacks do not qualify.
Light triggers from the landed Basic Attack while off cooldown, is a separate critical-eligible hit with its own cap, and takes 250% of the same total Armour stat Teragard's Aegis reads.
Perfidious reduces this tier-2 Light cooldown to 8 ticks; it does not change Lord of Light's independent 24-tick cooldown.

reason: Align Striking Light eligibility and cooldown ownership with current Basic Attack semantics and the Lord of Light clarification.

Grasp of Guthix activation requirement reduction
assumptions: The 4.8-second Light cooldown applies to Striking Light's tier-2 proc only; Lord of Light retains its own 14.4-second cooldown.
